Ladder up to power exhaust fan. Troubleshoot power exhaust. Was getting the signal from the carrier unit. But no exhaust fans coming on. Call MicroMetl. Had to go over VFD modes. VFD came shipped with wrong EPROM. MicroMetl sending a programmed EPROM.  LOTO external power exhaust for carrier unit. Got EPROM from MicroMetl. Return to job site and install. Remove old EPROM. Install new EPROM. Remove LOTO. Test power exhaust out. One fan going wrong direction. LOTO. Switch two leads to correct rotation.Remove LOTO. Check rotation again was ok.

Performed safety inspection. Performed inspection and heat start on unit #2. Sn# 3117U45797. Checked for correct phasing. Voltage 208/230. Average voltage 215 volts. Tightened electrical connections. Checked refrigerant charge in circuit A&B. Checked incoming gas pressure. Installed temporary thermostat to allow heat to run. Building still under construction. Incoming gas pressure 7.5 inches. Adjusted gas pressure to 3.5 inches. Documented paperwork and compressor information. Unit running and heating.

Arrived on site and checked in at front desk. Contractor not present. Facility crew not present. Escorted to roof hatch. Found unit by model serial number. Unable to connect to unit upc board. Need to reschedule. Closed hatch and checked out at desk.  Arrived at job site and checked in with customer. Inspected Carrier RTU#1 for bad UPC module. Verified all wiring and control power to module-ok. Using laptop accessed and uploaded module. UPC appeared to be locked up. Attempted a power cycle and restart. Module still starting up with error light. Performed software download to module and restarted. Module is now back on line and communicating. Checked all set points and configurations-ok. Also created a back up file of modules for rooftop units.  Travel to and from apple valley.

Upon startup CCS found DPT on circuit B reading 500#. Troubleshot DPTB. Ultimately found circuit B discharge piping is reading 200#. CCS found faulty DPTB. Contacted Phil to order a new DPTB. CCS will return to replace. Circuit B disabled in software. Buttoned up panels. Cleaned up work area.

Found bad duct pressure transducer on unit. Confirmed by swapping a working transducer from another unit. Installed new transducer. Alarm cleared on unit. Tested units fan by ramping slowly to check dp sensor. Sensor checks out. Job complete.

Found system with multiple alarm, found exhaust blower motor was configured on the VFD to run the wrong direction, had to reconfigured the parameters to the correct setting, also, found a bad connection between VFD and the CCN com bus, cleaned up harness connection, and put system back in operation, system back on line with no other alarm.  Checked out issues with rooftop unit not controlling building pressures correctly. Found exhaust fan vfd in alarm. Checked configuration parameters of exhaust vfd. Found vfd set for reverse rotation. Reset for forward rotation. Also found a loss of communication of MBB board to supply and exhaust fan vfd???s. Checked LEN communication wiring. Unplugged communication wiring from MBB board. Upon reconnecting board communication was restored.
